id: Things to Do in Denver When You're Dead (1995)

vibe.verdict: Right Denver, right crew and a neat Afterlife Advice nod, but the food is generic Colorado.
missing: Boat drinks in the afterlife (final scene)
The Man With The Plan (quadriplegic crime boss)
Mr. Shhh the hit man (stalking the crew)
Jimmy's video for his unborn child (Afterlife Advice)
ideas: Swap 'Blue Hawaiian' for a 'Boat Drink' named for the last scene.
Replace 'Mister Shhh drinks alone. Let him.' with 'Mister Shhh never fails. Tip him.'
Swap 'Sopapillas' blurb for a 'Last Meal' tag, nodding to Jimmy's last good night.
iconic: Afterlife Advice, the video business for the dying
The Man With The Plan and Jimmy's debt
changed: Queso note now nods to Mr. Shhh
Cue is now the Man With The Plan calling in the debt
